mapper.insert: insert into cm_translation_retries ( id, entity_type, entity_id, field_name, source_locale, target_locale, attempt_count, next_retry_at, last_error, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{fieldName}, #{sourceLocale}, #{targetLocale}, 1, date_add(now(), interval #{baseDelayMinutes} minute), left(#{errorMessage}, 1000), if(#{maxAttempts} <= 1, 'exhausted', 'pending'), now(), now() ) on duplicate key update source_locale = values(source_locale), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_at = date_add(now(), interval (#{baseDelayMinutes} * pow(2, least(attempt_count - 1, 10))) minute), last_error = values(last_error), status = if(attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts}, 'exhausted', 'pending'), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: select entity_type as entityType, entity_id as entityId, field_name as fieldName, source_locale as sourceLocale, target_locale as targetLocale, attempt_count as attemptCount from cm_translation_retries where status = 'pending' and attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} and next_retry_at <= now() order by next_retry_at, id limit #{batchSize}
